- Tue May 26, 9:00 AM PT / 12:00 PM ET / 17:00 BST (UK) / 18:00 CEST (EU)

I'll attach a tentative calendar invite and the mutual action plan so we can align next steps. If you confirm a slot I can send the Zoom link and add Jonas as host.

Thanks,

Thanks Ava  this looks good. Apologies for the tight window; we're trying to pull in our APAC integrator (based in SG) and they prefer late-evening EMEA times (which makes US mornings tricky).

Of the slots you proposed, the first on Tue May 26 at 17:00 BST / 18:00 CEST maps to 12:00 PM ET / 9:00 AM PT which would be ideal for our US folks, but our APAC colleague says they can only make 22:00 SGT (which is 15:00 BST)  so that one won't work for APAC.

Could we try: Wed May 27 at 16:00 BST / 17:00 CEST (which is 11:00 ET / 8:00 PT)? That would make it 23:00 SGT for APAC (still late but manageable for one person). If Jonas is okay with an earlier EU time, we'll take it.

Also  small note: we had some past confusion with DST conversions between the US and UK. Helpful if calendar invites include the timezone label (e.g., "17:00 BST / 18:00 CEST") rather than just local time.

Best,
